# netbox_device_front_ports (Data Source)

Lists device_front_port objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_front_ports" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-device_front_port" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: device_id, device_id__n, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, label, label__empty, label__ic, label__ie, label__iew, label__iregex, label__isw, label__n, label__nic, label__nie, label__niew, label__nisw, label__regex, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n, type, type__empty, type__ic, type__ie, type__iew, type__iregex, type__isw, type__n, type__nic, type__nie, type__niew, type__nisw, type__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `device_front_ports` (Attributes List) The matching device_front_ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device_front_ports))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--device_front_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `device_front_ports`

Read-Only:

- `color_hex` (String) RGB color in hex (e.g. ff0000).
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected.
- `module_id` (Number) Id of the installed module this component belongs to.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `positions` (Number) Number of positions on the front port, at least the number of rear_ports mappings. NetBox checks a lower value against the mappings it already holds, so remove mappings in one apply and lower positions in the next.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Rear port of a single-position front port: the same as rear_ports = [{position = 1, rear_port_id = ..., rear_port_position = ...}]. Conflicts with rear_ports and with positions > 1.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on rear_port_id. Requires rear_port_id.
- `rear_ports` (Attributes Set) Mappings of the front port's positions onto rear ports of the same device, one object per position. Derived from rear_port_id and rear_port_position when those are set; an empty set, or neither form, leaves the port unmapped. Changing the set recreates every mapping, since NetBox 4.6 rejects an update that resends an existing one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--device_front_ports--rear_ports))
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `type` (String) Port type as its NetBox slug, e.g. 8p8c, lc, mpo (any of NetBox's port type choices).
- `url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--device_front_ports--rear_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `device_front_ports.rear_ports`

Read-Only:

- `position` (Number) Position on the front port, 1-based and unique per port.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Id of the rear port the position maps to.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on that rear port, 1-based; each rear port position takes one mapping.
